research.text: Pokémon GO Wild Area–themed Field Research tasks will be available throughout the event! Complete the research tasks to earn encounters with event themed Pokémon and other rewards.
Once you’ve given your chosen trainee a Silver Bottle Cap, it’s time to start Hyper Training! To train, you will complete various tasks themed to the stat you plan to raise.
Attack: Battle alongside your trainee.

featured.text: Mega Chandelure Debut
For Mega Pokémon, we recommend the strongest one you have, but any Mega will suffice to break a Shield. Mega Tyranitar is great, as well as Mega Greninja.

raids.text: Mega Chandelure makes its Pokémon GO debut during Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day on Saturday, October 31, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time!
Expected event-exclusive Timed Research
Timed Research will be available during the event, with rewards including one Premium Battle Pass and an encounter with Tyranitar .
The tasks and other rewards below are expected based on Staraptor Super Mega Raid Day and will be confirmed when the event begins.
Complete the Timed Research tasks and claim their rewards before the research expires.
The Mega Raid Boss is always catchable in its base form, so the CP ranges are for a regular Chandelure. Chandelure can be caught with the following CP values:
From 1784 CP to 1867 CP , with no weather boost
From 2231 CP to 2335 CP with Fog and Sunny weather boost
Once the Mega Pokémon boss activates a shield , a Mega Pokémon from your Raid team will be automatically sent into the battle.
Your next attack by your Mega Pokémon will be significantly more powerful than usual, allowing you to break down the boss’s shield!
Once you and your fellow Trainers have broken enough shields, the Raid Boss will return to its normal state, and you will be able to do normal damage again.
All the best, Trainers!

moves.text: When three lines appear above a Pokémon’s head, it means it is being targeted by the Max Battle Boss. You can dodge the incoming attack by swiping to either the left or the right.
You have a 3-second countdown to choose the Pokémon you wish to use in the Max phase. You can pick any eligible Pokémon in your team, depending on which role you are fulfilling in your group.
Once your Max phase ends, you can immediately switch back to another Pokémon in your team if you wish to.
You can enter the Max phase more than once in a Max Battle whenever your Max Meter refills.
If all of your Pokémon faint while battling a 3-star or higher level Boss with other Trainers, you can still help your allies by cheering for them so that their meters fill faster.

It is also worth communicating with your fellow Trainers to ensure that those who may be less prepared, such as children who don’t have the resources of others, are included in groups that can help carry them through.
Using Max Guard shields you from incoming damage
20 HP for level 1
40 HP for level 2
60 HP for level 3
When stacked to a maximum of 3 shields it gives you:
120 HP for level 2

research.text: Pokémon GO Wild Area–themed Field Research tasks will be available throughout the event! Complete the research tasks to earn encounters with event themed Pokémon and other rewards.
Once you’ve given your chosen trainee a Silver Bottle Cap, it’s time to start Hyper Training! To train, you will complete various tasks themed to the stat you plan to raise.
Attack: Battle alongside your trainee.
Defense: Strengthen your bond with your Buddy Pokémon trainee by playing together, exploring, and catching Pokémon.

Once you use your Silver Bottle Cap, you’ll have 365 days to complete your Hyper Training. It’s a long and challenging course, but once you complete it your trainee will be stronger than ever!
—The Pokémon GO team

tickets.text: Trainers will receive the pass automatically on Monday, November 9, at 10:00 a.m. local time . Earn points and rank up until Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. local time .
GO Pass: Into the Wild is a free progression track. Complete Pass Tasks to collect GO Points, increase your rank, and unlock rewards.
From Monday, November 9, to Friday, November 13, you can collect GO Points up to a daily cap. There’s no limit to the GO Points you can earn on Saturday and Sunday, November 14 to 15!
Upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: Into the Wild for US$14.99 * for upgraded rewards. The GO Pass Deluxe: Into the Wild + 10 Ranks option costs US$19.99 * and grants enough GO Points to reach Rank 10.
Deluxe includes rewards from both tracks. You can upgrade at any time and still claim rewards for ranks you have already reached.
Claim all unlocked GO Pass rewards before they expire on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time .

GO Wild Area 2026 Tee (Purple) as a Free GO Pass reward
Duraludon Pants as a Paid GO Pass Deluxe reward
Duraludon T Shirt as part of the GO Pass Into the Wild
Trainers have until November 17, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time to claim their unlocked rewards.

shiny.text: Looking to enhance your GO Wild Area weekend with exclusive Special Research, additional bonuses, and an increased chance of encountering Shiny Pokémon? Purchase a global event ticket from the Pokémon GO Web Store !
Trainers may even encounter Shiny mighty Pokémon, if they’re lucky! Using the event-exclusive GO Safari Ball when trying to capture these Pokémon will greatly improve your chance of success.
Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia make their Pokémon GO debuts during GO Wild Area 2026. Both can be Shiny!
Ticket holders may attract mighty Latias and Latios with Incense, excluding Daily Adventure Incense, on both event days. Both can be Shiny and are quick to flee, so keep GO Safari Balls ready.
Mighty Pokémon are more likely to have high Attack, Defense, and HP ratings and be XL or XXL. They are harder to catch, and some may be Shiny. GO Safari Balls improve your chances of catching them.
Machamp wearing a modern jacket appears in three-star raids on both event days and may be Shiny.
Lucky Trainers may encounter Shiny Pokémon. Completing Black Kyurem and White Kyurem raids awards Fusion Energy. Kyurem encountered in raids may know the Charged Attack Glaciate .

costumes.text: Photo opportunities to capture the memories
Fun activities with local Community Ambassadors and their communities
Pokémon GO event pins and prints (while supplies last)
Timed Research when you check in at the official meetup
We are also partnering with local Community Ambassadors to add more PokéStops, Gyms, and Powerspots near the event area for these community meetups.
Look at the drip on Machamp! Machamp wearing a modern jacket* will appear in three-star raids on Saturday and Sunday.

The best way to experience Pokémon GO Wild Area is in-person. Meet you out there, Trainers!

tickets.text: These benefits apply from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time on both event days. The ticketed Raid Pass and Max Particle limits replace the free limits.

Trainers who attended an in-person GO Wild Area event can also receive this research by purchasing a separate Global ticket.
Both paths start with the same first step:
After it, you’ll pick your path. Choose wisely: you can select only one path, and you’ll stay on it until the end of the research.
The ticket covers both November 14 and 15 and includes the ticket holder bonuses, branching Special Research, additional Incense encounters, and hourly GO Safari Ball Supply Balloons described above.
Purchase the Global ticket .

dates.text: From October 4, 2026, to April 30, 2027, Trainers visiting participating science and space museums can discover special Pokémon GO gameplay inspired by the wonders of space, including encounters with Astronaut Pikachu!
Look to the skies, Trainers! From October 4 to October 10, 2026, these event-themed Pokémon will appear more frequently around participating locations.
All the above gameplay, excluding Location Backgrounds, will be available at the following ESA locations across Europe from October 4 to October 10, 2026.

events.title: Zorua Community Day
notes: 3x catch XP, 2x catch Candy and boosted Zorua spawns.
Evolve Zorua during the event or up to 4 hours after to get Zoroark with the exclusive Fast Attack Sucker Punch.
Lure and Special Trade bonuses run until 9 pm.
Wild Zorua can carry a special background.

bonuses.text: 3× XP for catching Pokémon.
2× Candy for catching Pokémon.
Incense (excluding Daily Adventure Incense) activated during the event will last for three hours.
Take a few snapshots during Community Day for a surprise!
Lure Modules will last for one hour and may attract the featured Pokémon.*
One additional Special Trade can be made for a maximum of two for the day.*
Trades will require 50% less Stardust.*

featured.text: Zorua will appear more frequently in the wild.*

research.text: For US$1.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access the Zorua Community Day–exclusive Special Research. Complete this research for even more rewards, including the following.
3 encounters with Zorua that have a Special Background
Additional encounters with Zorua
1 Premium Battle Pass
1 Rare Candy XL
Stay tuned for when tickets for the Special Research go live.
Don’t forget: You’re now able to purchase and gift tickets to any of your friends that you’ve achieved a Friendship level of Great Friends or higher with.
To gift a ticket, tap the Special Research ticket in the in-game shop, then tap the Gift button instead of the Buy button.

Tickets are nonrefundable (subject to applicable law and the exceptions set forth in the Terms of Service). Please note that this Special Research will not include an in-game medal and will not feature a story.

moves.text: Evolve Zorua during the event or up to four hours afterwards to get a Zoroark that knows the Fast Attack Sucker Punch.

tickets.text: For US$1.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access the Zorua Community Day–exclusive Special Research. Complete this research for even more rewards, including the following.
The Community Day Ultra Box will be available soon for US$1.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency) and includes an event ticket and five Ultra Balls!

dates.text: Saturday, October 10, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time

info.text: Zorua appears more often in the wild. With a regular Lure, Zorua is very likely at PokéStops from 2 to 9 pm.
No raids are listed for this event.
info.note: Not the same as none. Shown until a source says.

info.text: No egg changes are listed.
Zorua Field Research gives Stardust, Ultra Balls and extra Zorua encounters. Special Research is a paid ticket, below.
info.note: The specific Field Research tasks are not published yet.

info.text: Shiny Zorua is possible. Lured Zorua have a higher Shiny chance.
Evolve Zorua during the event, or within 4 hours after, for a Zoroark with Sucker Punch.
Special Background Zorua are possible but rare.
Community Ambassador check-in unlocks Timed Research with more Special Background Zorua.
